primary_source.title: The trouble with the minimal renormalizable SO(10) GUT
primary_source.equation: Eq. (6), with completeness cross-check below Eqs. (3)-(7) and coupling classification in Table II
primary_source.source_statement: The complete renormalizable complex-10 self-sector contains one hermitian quadratic norm, one complex holomorphic quadratic structure plus its conjugate, no cubic self-interaction, two real quartic coupling structures, and two complex quartic coupling structures plus their conjugates.

epistemic_limit: This freezes only the sourced 10_C,H self-sector. It does not establish the complete FToE scalar action, vacuum, Hessian, heavy spectrum, thresholds, or publication readiness.
